name: t12_upkeep_exact
doc: World-depth Stage 5, slice 2b (2026-11-26), chance-free: tick to heal and upkeep on a self-counter. A: Bitter Medicine (below 10 Poison stacks a Poison tick on A deals nothing and heals A for half of it; at 10 or more it hurts as usual); a ward weave that adds a Ward stack (block +3 each) costing 2 % of maximum linh lực per stack each pulse, so the stacks the pool cannot pay end; a Stele charge every 4 s, each on its own 6 s, costing 1 % of maximum health per charge each pulse (L5 +0.5 each). B: venom laying 4 Poison stacks for 8 s every 2.5 s, so A's Poison crosses 10 and back, and a plain cut.
